map.逐字符取码点，满足下列任一条件才编码：开启全部编码，或码点大于 127，或字符是: Take the code point of each character; encode only when any of these holds: encode-all is enabled, the code point is greater than 127, or the character is an ampersand, less-than, greater-than, double quote or single quote. In named mode, output a named entity when one exists; in decimal mode, output ampersand hash plus the decimal code point plus semicolon; in hex mode, output ampersand hash x plus the hex code point plus semicolon; otherwise fall back to decimal form. Characters that do not meet the encoding condition are kept as-is. Decoding uses a single plain-text scan: match three forms (&#decimal / &#xhex / &named), with the semicolon optional; named entities are looked up only in this page table, and when the semicolon is omitted only the common HTML5 legacy subset (amp/lt/gt/quot/nbsp/copy/reg) is decoded. Code points above 0x10FFFF or inside the surrogate range 0xD800-0xDFFF are kept as-is. No DOM is built and the input is never assigned to innerHTML, so decoding triggers no external resource requests and never decodes a produced ampersand a second time
